name: Return to Brock
summary: You carry Brock Stoneseeker's missive to Ironforge and receive Honorary Picks for the return to Thelsamar. Gryth Thurden can take you across the mountains by gryphon.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: Gryth Thurden oversees Ironforge's gryphon flights from the city's central platform. The roosts link the mountain stronghold with settlements such as Loch Modan, carrying messages and trade between them. Before you can fly to Thelsamar, you need to have met its handler, Thorgrum Borrelson. Once that is done, Gryth can send you back with the picks.

sections.title: Picks for the Pupils
sections.body: Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar and needs tools for his apprentices. The Honorary Picks you carry will let young miners work the copper and tin veins in the hills around the Loch.

faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker is a dwarf mining trainer in Thelsamar, Loch Modan. He teaches new miners to gather ore and stone from the surrounding hills.

faq.q: Why do I need to fly on a gryphon to finish this quest?
faq.answer: Gryth Thurden can fly you to Thelsamar because you have already visited its roost and spoken with Thorgrum Borrelson. Gryphons carry travelers only to aeries they have visited.

faq.q: What are the Honorary Picks for?
faq.answer: The Honorary Picks are mining tools Brock Stoneseeker needs for his new students in Loch Modan.
Gryth Thurden is Ironforge's gryphon master, stationed at the Great Forge. He manages flights to and from the capital across Khaz Modan and beyond.

faq.q: Can I just walk back to Thelsamar instead of flying?
aliases: do i have to take gryphon
faq.answer: You can walk back to Thelsamar and deliver the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker. The journey introduces you to gryphon routes, but Brock needs the tools safely in his hands.

faq.q: Where in Thelsamar is Brock located?
faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker is outdoors near Thelsamar's forge and anvil, where he helps miners in Loch Modan.

angles.text: Delivering the Honorary Picks gives Loch Modan's new miners tools for their work and carries on the dwarven tradition of excavation and prospecting.
As a dwarf, you know how Wildhammer gryphons and Ironforge handlers link the dwarven holds by air.
